日.story: A square window with one bar across the middle lets the sunlight pour in, announcing a brand-new **day**.

一.story: A single chopstick lying flat on the table: just **one** stroke, nothing more.

国.story: A precious **jewel** (玉) sits safe inside a strong **enclosure** (囗) of walls, the treasure every **country** guards.

人.story: Two legs striding apart down the road, a figure caught mid-step: a **person** out for a walk.

年.story: One **slash** (丿) of the sickle cuts the grain, then it hangs up to **dry** (干); a harvest like this comes once a **year**.

大.story: A man flings his arms out as wide as they go to show just how **big** the fish he caught was.

十.story: Two sticks cross like a plus sign; add up the fingers on both hands and you get **ten**.

二.story: Two flat lines, a short one floating above a longer one, like a pair of chopsticks: **two**.

千.story: Add one quick **slash** (丿) on top of **ten** (十) and the count shoots all the way up to a **thousand**.

木.story: A trunk rises straight up, branches stretch out to the sides, and roots spread down into the ground: a **tree**.

本.story: A line marks the base of a **tree** (木) where its roots begin; from that wood comes the paper for every **book**.

中.story: A **line** (丨) shoots straight through a wide-open **mouth** (口), hitting it right in the **middle**.

長.story: Picture an elder with **long** hair streaming in the wind, leaning on a staff as he leads the village.

山.story: Three peaks rise from one flat base, the tallest standing proud in the center: a **mountain**.

出.story: A **mountain** (山) shoves its way up and out of an **open box** (凵), bursting free to **go out** into the world.

三.story: Stack **one** (一) line on another, then add one more: three bars piled up make **three**.

時.story: Each **day** (日), the monks at the **temple** (寺) ring the bell on every hour to keep track of the **time**.

行.story: Take one **step** (彳) after another at the crossroads, and keep **going** wherever the road leads.

見.story: A giant **eye** (目) strolls around on two **legs** (儿), going everywhere just to **see** everything.

月.story: A crescent hangs in the night sky with two wisps of cloud drifting across it: the **moon**.

後.story: Taking slow **steps** (彳) and trailing a **short thread** (幺), the slowpoke can only **go** (夂) so fast and ends up **behind**.

八.story: Two strokes lean away from each other like a tent with its flaps thrown open: the number **eight**.

前.story: For **eight** (八) **months** (月) the chef has stood **in front** of the stove with his **knife** (刂), arriving before anyone else.

生.story: A sprout pushes up through the soil, adding leaves on its stem as it climbs toward the sun: new **life**.

五.story: Between **two** (二) lines, a zigzag weaves back and forth like a hand counting off all **five** fingers.

間.story: Through the gap in a **gate** (門), a slice of **day**light (日) shines into the **space** between the doors.

上.story: A **divination** rod (卜) stands upright on **one** (一) flat line, pointing toward the sky: **up**.

東.story: Every **day** (日) begins when the sun peeks through the **tree** (木) branches on the **east** side of the village.

四.story: A pair of **legs** (儿) paces inside a square **enclosure** (囗), touching each of its **four** walls in turn.

今.story: A **person** (人) holds up **one** (一) finger and says: not later, not tomorrow, right **now**!

金.story: Under a pointed roof lies a mound of earth where two little nuggets sparkle: buried **gold**.

九.story: One **slash** (丿) and a hooked **second** (乙) stroke curl like the tail of a cat with **nine** lives.

入.story: Two strokes lean together like the flap of a tent that you duck under to **enter**.

子.story: A baby wrapped snugly in a blanket, only its little arms poking out to the sides: a **child**.

学.story: Under the schoolhouse **cover** (冖), a **child** (子) bends over **small** (⺍) books to **study**.

高.story: A **lid** (亠) caps a tower whose windows gape like a **mouth** (口) over the wide **prairie** (冋); it stands very **tall**.

円.story: An **upside-down box** (冂) with a slot in it makes a piggy bank where round coins clink in: **yen**.

外.story: In the **evening** (夕), the fortune-teller does her **divination** (卜) under the stars, **outside** the house.

六.story: Put a **lid** (亠) on **eight** (八) cookies and two vanish while you aren't looking: only **six** are left.

下.story: A **divination** rod (卜) dangles beneath **one** (一) ceiling line, pointing **down** at the floor.

来.story: A bundle of **rice** (米) stalks with an extra bar on top waves in the wind like a hand beckoning: **come** here!

気.story: **Steam** (气) rises over freshly **mowed** grass (乂), and that fresh air lifts your **spirit**.

小.story: A tall stroke with two tiny dots tumbling off its sides, like crumbs falling from something **small**.

七.story: **One** (一) line slashed by a hooked **second** (乙) stroke looks like a 7 flipped upside down: **seven**.

話.story: You **say** (言) things by wagging your **tongue** (舌); that is how people **talk**.

女.story: A figure kneeling gracefully, her arms crossed elegantly in front of her: a **woman**.

北.story: Two people sit back to back, each clutching a **spoon** (匕), turning away from the icy wind of the **north**.

午.story: One **slash** (丿) of blazing sunlight leaves the laundry bone **dry** (干): it must be **noon**.

白.story: One ray of light sparks from the top of the **day**'s sun (日), so bright it looks pure **white**.

百.story: **One** (一) stroke on top of a **white** (白) stack of paper: a neat pile of a **hundred** sheets.

書.story: A **brush** (聿) dances over the paper all **day** (日) long as you sit and **write**.

先.story: Long **legs** (儿) race beneath a sprouting head, always one stride **ahead** of everyone else.

名.story: In the dark **evening** (夕) no one can see faces, so your **mouth** (口) calls out each person's **name**.

川.story: Three lines run side by side down the page, like water flowing between two banks: a **river**.

水.story: A central stream with splashes flying off both sides, as if poured onto a rock: **water**.

半.story: **Dots** (丶) fly as a cleaver chops through **two** (二) bars and a **ten** (十) cross, splitting them exactly in **half**.

男.story: Using all his **power** (力) in the **rice field** (田), he plows from dawn to dusk: a strong **male** farmhand.

西.story: A wooden crate with a lid on top fills with orange light as the sun sinks into the **west**.

雨.story: Under a wide roof of cloud, four drops fall in neat little rows: **rain**.

電.story: Out of the **rain** (雨) clouds, a bolt flashes bright as **day** (日), crackling with **electricity**.

校.story: Kids **mingle** (交) under the shade of a big **tree** (木) at recess: welcome to **school**.

語.story: **I** (吾) **say** (言) what is on my mind in my own **language**.

土.story: A cross planted firmly on a flat line of ground, like a stake pushed deep into the **soil**.

聞.story: Pressing an **ear** (耳) to the crack in the **gate** (門), you **hear** every word of the gossip inside.

食.story: A lid sits on top of a steaming rice bowl on its stand, ready for you to **eat**.

車.story: Seen from above, an axle runs through a box-shaped cart with a wheel at each end: a **car**.

何.story: A **person** (亻) scratches their head: I **can** (可) do it, but do **what**?

南.story: **Ten** (十) sun rays beat on an **upside-down box** (冂) until everything inside is bone **dry** (干): the hot **south**.

万.story: **One** (一) roof beam with a hooked crane swinging beneath it, hauling up **ten thousand** bricks at once.

毎.story: Wearing her hat (𠂉), Mom warns **do not** (毋) be late, and she says it **every** single morning.

天.story: Above a **large** (大) person stretching out wide, **one** (一) more line marks the endless **heavens**.

母.story: Two little dots huddle inside her arms as she warns **do not** (毋) wander off: a caring **mother**.

火.story: Flames leap up from a central stick while two sparks pop off the sides: a crackling **fire**.

右.story: A hand (丆) reaches over to bring food to your **mouth** (口); most people eat with their **right** hand.

読.story: To **sell** (売) a book, you **say** (言) its best lines out loud so everyone wants to **read** it.

友.story: Two hands, one reaching out (𠂇) and one **right hand** (又), clasp in a handshake between good **friends**.

左.story: One hand steadies the nail while you work at your **craft** (工); the hammer goes in the other, so this one is your **left**.

休.story: A tired **person** (亻) leans back against a shady **tree** (木) to **rest**.

父.story: Two sparks fly above a crossed pair of axes: a hard-working **father** chopping firewood.

会.story: A **person** (人) on top **says** (云) hello to everyone gathered below at the **meeting**.

口.story: An open square like a wide-open **mouth**, ready for a big bite.

同.story: Under one **upside-down box** (冂) roof, every **mouth** (口) speaks with **one** (一) voice: all the **same**.

事.story: A **mouth** (口) on top, a **snout** (⺕) in the middle and a **hook** (亅) through it all: what a strange **thing**!

目.story: Turn an **eye** on its side: the frame is the lids, and the two bars are the pupil peering out.

自.story: A little stroke on top of an **eye** (目) is the nose you point at when you mean **oneself**.

社.story: Workers bow at an **altar** (礻) built on the **soil** (土) where their **company** first broke ground.

発.story: **Footsteps** (癶) pound the track as **two** (二) **legs** (儿) spring off the starting line: the runner's **departure**.

者.story: An **old** (耂) man sits in the sun every **day** (日), a familiar **person** everyone in town knows.

地.story: Scoop up the **soil** (土) and declare: here it shall **be** (也), the solid **ground** under our feet.

業.story: Shearing **sheep** (羊) and cutting **trees** (木) from dawn to dusk: the family **business** never rests.

方.story: Under a **lid** (亠), a signpost arm swings out and points you in one **direction**.

立.story: Under a **lid** (亠) of sky, a person plants both feet on the ground to **stand up** tall.

新.story: **Stand up** (立) by the **tree** (木), swing your **axe** (斤), and chop fresh timber for something **new**.

場.story: A patch of **soil** (土) lying **open** to the sun (昜): the perfect **place** for a picnic.

員.story: Every **mouth** (口) at the **shellfish** (貝) stall belongs to a hungry staff **member** on lunch break.

開.story: Hands lift the bar (开) from across the **gate** (門) and swing both doors wide **open**.

手.story: A palm with three creases and a wrist line running down: a **hand** raised to wave hello.

力.story: A bent arm flexes its bicep, ready to lift something heavy with all its **power**.
